entities.summary: Giulio Ulisse Arata was an Italian architect. His work was part of the architecture event in the art competition at the 1936 Summer Olympics. One of his most notable works is the Bologna Football Stadium (1927). he also designed the Galleria d'arte moderna Ricci Oddi in Piacenza.
